name: Anfortas

attributes.attribute: a name for the Fisher King in Grail tales

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Anfortas is the name given to the Fisher King in some versions of the Grail story. He is the wounded keeper of the Holy Grail. See Fisher King.
objective: Record Anfortas, a name of the Fisher King.
key_results: Show his link to the Grail and to the Fisher King.
evidence: Monaghan 2003, s.v. Anfortas; Koch 2006, s.v. Anfortas
